beats.detail: How bold? How much upkeep? Find your best fits.
beats.caption: Not sure yet? Start with you.
beats.narration: Haven't decided? Choose how big a change you want and how much upkeep you're happy with. DyeCast ranks the colors that fit your starting point.

beats.detail: Compare the best-fit colors on your own photo.
beats.caption: Try possibilities before committing.
beats.narration: Compare those looks on your own photo. The quick preview runs on your device. It's a visual guide, not a promise of a salon result.

beats.headline: The promise.
beats.detail: Put the box beside a forecast for your starting hair.
beats.caption: Compare the box with your forecast.
beats.narration: Now check a box. The forecast puts its promise next to your likely result. YouCam Hair Color renders both on your photo. Dark hair cannot simply become platinum from one box.

beats.headline: Explore privately.
beats.detail: Photos are optional. Processing is your choice.
beats.caption: Optional photos. Explicit consent.
beats.narration: Photos are optional. You choose when YouCam receives a cleaned copy. Stored selfies are off by default, and local previews clear when you sign out.

beats.headline: Your color.
